name: Anja Baumgartner
bio:
Anja's journey into the world of motorsport was somewhat unconventional. Initially drawn to the intricate networks powering financial institutions, she found herself increasingly fascinated by the real-time data analysis crucial to optimizing race car performance. After a stint at Siemens, she transitioned to Formula E, where she honed her skills in managing complex IT infrastructures under intense pressure. Now at Toyota Gazoo Racing, Anja brings a meticulous and data-driven approach to her role, ensuring that the team's IT systems are not only reliable but also constantly evolving to meet the demands of modern racing. She is passionate about leveraging cutting-edge technologies to gain a competitive edge on the track.

Her demanding nature stems from a deep-seated belief that perfection is achievable through relentless pursuit and attention to detail. She expects her team to share her commitment and strives to create a culture of continuous improvement. Anja has implemented several innovative IT solutions, including a custom-built data visualization platform that has significantly improved the team's ability to analyze race data in real-time. Her colleagues both admire and respect her high standards, knowing that her efforts ultimately contribute to the team's success. She is most proud of how she fosters collaborative innovation and team work, so that IT is not just a support function, but rather, an enabler of performance.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, sleek and straight with a precise side part.
physical.description: Anja has a sharp, focused look, complemented by her minimalist style.
